title: The Witch and the Mercenary
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a land where witches are feared and hunted, the mercenary Zig is hired to kill the witch Siasha. After their duel she asks him instead to protect her, since she only wants to live in peace. The pair leave for an unknown continent where magic is common, adventurers have a guild and monsters roam, looking for somewhere she can survive.
life_message: Two outcasts the world treats as disposable find survival, and some dignity, by trusting each other.

content.note: Mercenary killing for pay and monster fights (MU Blood and Gore, Violence; ANN light-novel review).
